title: Valuing Requested Units in Northgate Marketplace Not-As-Described Claims
content:
**Valuation rule — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The merchandise value of the requested units still unrefunded in the amount claimed for an item not as described depends on how the line was priced and what was already refunded on it: where the line is set-priced, that is its line amount is below its listed unit price times the units bought, and it carries unit refunds on fewer units than were bought, it is what remains of the line amount after the listed unit price of every unit already refunded on it, divided by the units not yet refunded, times the requested units still unrefunded; where the line is set-priced and carries no unit refund, or unit refunds on every unit bought, it is the price paid for the requested units still unrefunded; on a line that is not set-priced it is the listed unit price times the requested units still unrefunded.

**Terms.** A line is set-priced when its line amount is below its listed unit price times the units bought; a line amount equal to that product is not set-priced. Units already refunded on the line are counted by the units its unit refund entries refund; an entry that refunds no units counts none.

| Line | Unit refunds on the line | Merchandise value of the requested units still unrefunded |
|---|---|---|
| set-priced | on at least one unit and fewer units than were bought | what remains of the line amount after the listed unit price of every unit already refunded, divided by the units not yet refunded, times the requested units still unrefunded |
| set-priced | none, or on every unit bought | the price paid for the requested units still unrefunded (set price per unit times the requested units still unrefunded) |
| not set-priced | any | the listed unit price times the requested units still unrefunded |

**Hypothetical line (illustration only).** Take a line of 4 units listed at USD 50.00 with a line amount of USD 170.00, so set-priced, and 2 units as the requested units still unrefunded. With 1 unit already refunded on it, what remains is 170.00 less 50.00, that is 120.00, divided by the 3 units not yet refunded, that is 40.00 a unit, and the merchandise value is 80.00. With no unit refunded, it is the set price per unit of 42.50 times 2, that is 85.00. On a line of the same 4 units with a line amount of exactly 200.00, which is not set-priced, it is 50.00 times 2, that is 100.00.
